_comment: Plan 12 Phase 6 — optional starter pack of vendor reference docs.
Each entry below was verified via WebFetch on the date listed in `accessed`.
Skipped vendors (403 / login wall / no public PDF):
- Cisco IOS-XE command reference: cisco.com returns HTTP 403 to non-
browser User-Agents on the canonical /c/en/us/td/docs/... PDFs.
- Cisco IOS-XE configuration guide: same anti-crawler protection.
- Cisco NX-OS command reference: same anti-crawler protection.
- Arista EOS command reference: arista.com gates manuals behind a
customer login (ar-website cookie required). Public mirror not
When you (the human) have a browser session open, you can manually drag
those PDFs into Settings → RAG → drop zone after running the starter
pack. The two entries below are the verified-public ones that download
without authentication and form a useful baseline.
